resources.string:
This tile needs the thor-screenmove Magisk module and root access.

Magisk 31 no longer asks when an app requests root, so no prompt will appear. Add “Thor screen move” with the + button in Magisk → Superuser, then tap again.

If the module is not installed, flash thor-screenmove and reboot.
Neither screen is showing an app to move — only launchers.\n\nOpen an app, then tap this tile to send it to the other screen.
